lines.level.mechanic.embers.bypass: Yi faɗa kamar yadda aka saba; kasakai na fashewa ne kawai idan an buge su.

lines.level.mechanic.frostglass.bypass: Zauna a kan hanyoyin dutse: babbar hanya ba ta taɓa yin ƙanƙara.

lines.level.mechanic.gale.bypass: Ƙetare tsakanin hurawar iska, ko zagaya hanyoyin.

lines.level.mechanic.gloom.bypass: Zauna kusa da babbar hanya mai haske: fatalwowin haske na haskaka hanyar fita.

lines.level.mechanic.mire.bypass: Ratsa taɓon a hankali ko zagaye shi; babbar hanya na kasancewa a bushe.
